name: Dover Court International School
summary: Inclusive Nord Anglia school frequently shortlisted for learning-support capacity — Pathway programmes are real, and places are constrained.
body: Dover Court (Nord Anglia) is one of the first names expat parents hear when a child needs structured learning support alongside an English National Curriculum / IGCSE / IB pathway. Forum threads on relocating with autism / SEN repeatedly shortlist Dover Court beside SAS — and warn that Pathway / support seats are capacity-constrained with multi-month waits in peak years. Admissions typically require Dependant Pass, LTVP, Immigration Exemption Order, PR, or citizenship with MOE exemption — Student’s Pass enrolment is not supported. Pathway 2/3 supportive education needs specialist reports and school assessment; Singapore Citizens need MOE approval, which is discretionary. Bring current psychological / paediatric documentation and ask admissions for written confirmation of the pathway they can staff this academic year before you resign overseas. Do not treat local Pathlight-style SPED as a foreigner fallback.
waitlistNotes: Support / Pathway places are capacity-constrained; early clinical reports and honest disclosure help. Confirm current wait guidance with admissions — community reports of long waits should be verified live.
